title: Historical usage normalization and fingerprint reconciliation
creator: Avery Chen
description: We need a safe, idempotent pass to normalize historical usage events across the console telemetry pipeline. Over the last 12 months we introduced several client-side fingerprint changes (session_id -> session_fingerprint v2) and a compacted event envelope. This divergence produces duplicated sessions, split token counts, and misattributed costs in per-customer dashboards. The goal is an auditable reprocessing job that: 1) reconciles legacy and v2 fingerprints into canonical session identifiers, 2) normalizes token_count and duration fields according to the current schema, and 3) emits a delta-layer so downstream billing and cost dashboards can apply corrections without overriding raw events.
acceptance_criteria: A checkpointed re-run can process 30 days of historical data for a single workspace within 6 hours on staging cluster
Reconciled session mapping file produced with deterministic keys and a documented checksum for audit
Downstream billing pipeline accepts delta events (operation: upsert/patch) and reflects corrected totals in the cost dashboard within 48 hours of applying the delta
All runs are idempotent: re-running the same token range produces identical outputs and no double-counting
Run exposes per-workspace progress metrics and a dry-run mode that writes reconciliation manifests without mutating downstream state
implementation_steps: Add fingerprint reconciliation module to ingest worker: translates legacy fingerprint variants to canonical id using ordered rules and fuzzy matching fallbacks
Create a standalone reprocessor CLI that can be invoked with start/end timestamps, work queue shard, and --dry-run flag
Integrate a manifest writer that emits reconciliation_map.{workspace}.{start}.{end}.ndjson with SHA256 checksum
Extend DeltaEmitter service to publish correction events to analytics-corrections topic with idempotency token and original_event_ref
Add orchestration manifest in airflow for staged rollout: small sample -> full workspace -> cross-check -> apply deltas
Add tests for collision cases (same fingerprint across multiple workspaces in legacy period), timestamp skew, and partial schema fields
comments: 2025-02-11 Avery Chen: Initial triage — identified primary divergence in fingerprint hashing salt change introduced 2024-09. Proposed canonicalization by prefixing source-version and canonicalizing via longest-common-subsequence when exact match fails.

2025-02-18 Priya Patel: Scoped execution window to avoid peak hours; recommended staged rollout and dry-run telemetry. Linked Confluence spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ANALYTICS/Fingerprint+Reconciliation+Design

2025-02-20 Marcus Rivera (eng review): Raised concern about fuzzy matching causing false merges. Added requirement for manual review bucket for low-confidence merges; suggested threshold 0.92 similarity for auto-merge.
2025-02-25 Sofia Nguyen (data eng): Prototype manifest writer and delta emitter in feature branch. See PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/analytics-reprocessor/pull/482

2025-03-02 Priya Patel: Ran full staging dry-run for 2024-11-01 -> 2024-11-30 (workspace-abc123). Results: 1.2% session merges, 430 manifest entries flagged low-confidence. Performance: 4.6 hours CPU-bound on large shard. Next: optimize lookup table and add memcached tier for fingerprint index.
